cues.text: Your Sunday versus your pet's Sunday. Let's compare, hour by hour.
Nine a.m. You do laundry. They nap.
Noon. Groceries. They flip to the other side.
Three p.m. You meal prep. They supervise.
Nine p.m. Sunday scaries for you. Zoomies for them.
So who's really winning here? Honestly, not us.
PETTO. Free on iOS and Android.
